assumptions: Ten pre-existing gates retain unchanged criteria and weights. This is conditional coverage, not a prediction, measured saving or current score.
Native descriptor/ownership/archive tests plus pinned driver, app and IPA must pass before M5 implementation gates earn credit.
M5 same-event first/repeat/restart comparison must separate cache states, verify native capability and persistence, preserve correctness and demonstrate reduced representative severe stalls.

Preparation receipts must be included with loading and gameplay cost. Net energy acceptance requires matched supported power/battery and temperature evidence; one API step or nominal thermal state is insufficient.
M3-D2 needs representative CPU/GPU/presentation attribution with coverage/exclusion limitations. New labels and Mach identity only enable this; their existence cannot pass the physical gate.

M6-D3 requires actual aspect/input/latency/lifecycle/buffering regression checks for the tested presentation path, including external observation if needed. Existing source guards alone do not suffice.
Unknown Instruments/physical-equipment availability remains a blocker. A short successful capability check cannot pass this whole scenario.
No other milestone gates, core-residency claim, strict Adaptive energy, MetalFX net energy or Duo acceptance are assumed. Keep failures/inconclusive results and original-driver rollback.
